acceptanceCriteria: Run receipts name the decision that fixes the three Core jobs and the verb set they were measured against, and the spec's acceptance evidence cites the same decision.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #87 (V1-0012 daily-loop measurement, run-001). The run-001 receipts pin repositoryRevision but not decision 0332 (12 Core verbs), so a reader cannot tell which verb contract the jobs were measured under.
title: daily-loop bench: receipts cite `repositoryRevision` without the decision 0332 Core-verb citation
